name: MA L WORLD
summary: This EA uses a linearly weighted moving average (LWMA) crossover signal between a fast 12-period and slow 25-period MA to generate trade entries and exits. It trails positions using a 92-period EMA and manages risk with a fixed-margin money management module allocating 1% of margin per trade. The strategy is a standard MQL5 Standard Library-based trend following system with configurable signal thresholds and stop/take levels.
summary_zh: 该EA使用12周期快速LWMA与25周期慢速LWMA的交叉信号来产生交易入场和出场。它通过92周期EMA进行移动止损，并使用固定保证金资金管理模块，每笔交易分配1%的保证金。这是一个基于MQL5标准库的经典趋势跟踪系统，具有可配置的信号阈值和止损/止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于两条移动平均线的交叉来判断趋势方向：快速MA（12周期LWMA）上穿慢速MA（25周期LWMA）时产生买入信号，下穿时产生卖出信号。入场条件由信号阈值（ThresholdOpen=20）控制，只有当信号强度超过阈值时才开仓，信号强度低于关闭阈值（ThresholdClose=20）时平仓。出场条件包括固定止损（95点）和止盈（670点），同时使用92周期EMA作为移动止损跟踪趋势。仓位管理采用固定保证金比例方式，每笔交易使用1%的可用保证金，由CMoneyFixedMargin类实现。资金管理方面，止盈远大于止损（670:95约7:1的盈亏比），表明该策略依赖少数大盈利覆盖多次小亏损的趋势跟踪典型特征。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于经典的MA交叉趋势跟踪系统，但缺乏对震荡市场的过滤机制和更复杂的风险控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the crossover of two moving averages to determine trend direction: a buy signal is generated when the fast MA (12-period LWMA) crosses above the slow MA (25-period LWMA), and a sell signal when it crosses below. Entry conditions are controlled by a signal threshold (ThresholdOpen=20), where trades are only opened when signal strength exceeds the threshold, and positions are closed when signal strength drops below the close threshold (ThresholdClose=20). Exit conditions include a fixed stop loss at 95 points and take profit at 670 points, along with a 92-period EMA trailing stop to follow trends. Position sizing uses a fixed margin percentage approach, allocating 1% of available margin per trade through the CMoneyFixedMargin class. In terms of money management, the take profit is significantly larger than the stop loss (670:95, approximately 7:1 reward-to-risk ratio), which is characteristic of trend-following strategies that rely on a few large winners to cover multiple small losses. The overall strategy logic is clear and follows a classic MA crossover trend-following approach, but it lacks filters for ranging markets and more sophisticated risk controls.

pros: 使用MQL5标准库（CExpert框架），代码结构规范、模块化程度高，易于维护和扩展
止盈止损比约为7:1，符合趋势跟踪策略的高盈亏比特征，有利于长期正期望
采用固定保证金比例的资金管理方式，每笔仅使用1%保证金，风险控制较为保守
移动止损使用独立的92周期EMA，能有效跟踪趋势并保护已有利润
信号阈值机制提供了额外的入场过滤，避免在信号较弱时盲目开仓
pros_en: Uses the MQL5 Standard Library (CExpert framework) with well-structured, modular code that is easy to maintain and extend
The reward-to-risk ratio of approximately 7:1 (670:95) aligns with trend-following strategy principles and supports long-term positive expectancy
Employs fixed margin percentage money management at 1% per trade, providing conservative risk control
Trailing stop uses an independent 92-period EMA, which effectively follows trends and protects accumulated profits
The signal threshold mechanism provides additional entry filtering, preventing trades on weak signals
cons: 策略过于简单，仅依赖MA交叉单一信号，在震荡行情中会产生大量虚假信号和频繁亏损
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线内重复开仓，增加不必要的交易成本
没有点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在高点差时段或流动性不足时仍会交易
固定止损95点在不同波动率环境下表现差异巨大，未考虑ATR等动态止损方式
信号权重设为1.0且仅有一个过滤器，无法通过多信号确认来提高入场质量
cons_en: The strategy is overly simplistic, relying solely on MA crossover as a single signal, which generates numerous false signals and frequent losses in ranging markets
Lacks a new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions within the same bar and increasing unnecessary trading costs
No spread filter or trading session filter, meaning it will still trade during high-spread periods or low liquidity hours
Fixed stop loss of 95 points performs very differently under varying volatility conditions, without considering dynamic stops like ATR-based levels
Signal weight is set to 1.0 with only one filter, unable to improve entry quality through multi-signal confirmation
improvements: 增加震荡市场过滤器（如ADX或ATR阈值），在低趋势强度时禁止交易以减少虚假信号
加入新K线检查和点差过滤，避免同一K线重复开仓和在高点差时段交易
考虑使用基于ATR的动态止损替代固定点数止损，使风险管理适应市场波动率变化
improvements_en: Add a ranging market filter (such as ADX or ATR threshold) to disable trading during low trend strength periods and reduce false signals
Implement new bar checking and spread filtering to prevent repeated entries on the same bar and trading during high-spread periods
Consider using ATR-based dynamic stop loss instead of fixed point stops, making risk management adaptive to market volatility changes

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓导致过度交易
固定止损95点未考虑市场波动率，在高波动品种上可能过于紧密而被频繁止损
无点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下入场
单一MA交叉信号在震荡市中容易产生连续亏损
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially causing over-trading through repeated entries within the same bar
Fixed 95-point stop loss does not account for market volatility, which may be too tight on volatile instruments and trigger frequent stops
No spread filter or trading session filter, potentially entering under unfavorable conditions
Single MA crossover signal is prone to consecutive losses in ranging markets
